detail.longDescription: One coding agent rewrote the same copyleft repo three times with the same prompt. JPlag similarity to the original: 48.2%, 2.2%, 38.7%. In 7 of 18 project and agent setups, repeat runs fell on both sides of a 25% cutoff. Repetition explained 61% of score variance, agent choice 0.1%. A single low score, which maintainers sometimes cite as proof of independence, is one draw from a very wide distribution. https:// arxiv.org/abs/2611.07887 # OpenSource # AIAgents # Copyleft
